item.title: From cold profile to 200 enterprise meetings: a LinkedIn growth case study
item.description: Most LinkedIn profiles in B2B look the same. A headshot, a job title, a list of previous roles. No clear message. No reason for anyone to connect, follow, or reach out. That was the starting point when I began working with the founder of a Dubai-based AI software company serving the GCC retail market. His LinkedIn had around 400 connections. Mostly old colleagues and people he had met at events. No strategy. No outreach. No pipeline coming from the platform.

item.title: The LinkedIn profile optimization guide for B2B outreach
item.description: Most people treat LinkedIn profile optimization as a one-time task they do when they first create an account. They upload a photo, write a headline, add their work history and move on. Then they launch an outreach campaign and wonder why the results are disappointing.

item.title: The 5 mistakes B2B founders make in their first outreach campaign
item.description: Most founders launch their first LinkedIn outreach campaign with good intentions and poor results. The problem is rarely the product. It is almost always the execution. Here are the five mistakes that kill response rates before the conversation even starts.

item.title: Why your LinkedIn profile matters before outreach starts
item.description: Outreach does not happen only inside the message box. It also happens on the profile page, where trust is either supported or damaged.
